**VERDICT: REJECT** **Overall Assessment**: The component implements the visual and interaction mechanics of infinite scroll but fails to communicate state changes to assistive technology. Screen reader users will be completely unaware that new content has loaded, effectively breaking the core utility of the feature for them. Additionally, the component lacks landmark structure and loading feedback. **Pre-commitment Predictions**: 1. Missing `aria-live` region for announcing new items (Critical). 2. Missing loading state (`aria-busy`) during API calls (Critical). 3. Missing `
` landmark wrapper (Major). 4. List items likely lack focusability if they are meant to be interactive (Major). **Critical Findings** (blocks access): 1. **Missing Live Region for Dynamic Content Updates** - **Evidence**: `src/components/BuggyInfiniteScroll.tsx:38` (`{items.map(...)}`) updates the DOM, but no element has `aria-live`. - **User Group Impacted**: Screen reader users (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver). - **WCAG/APG Citation**: WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages; WAI-ARIA APG Dynamic Content patterns. - **Why this matters**: When `loadMore` appends items to the list, screen reader users hear absolutely nothing. They will scroll to the bottom repeatedly, assuming the page is broken or finished. - **Fix**: Add a live region that updates when loading completes. Example: `
{isLoading ? 'Loading more items...' : ''}
` inside the container. 2. **Missing Loading State (`aria-busy`)** - **Evidence**: `src/components/BuggyInfiniteScroll.tsx:13` (`const loadMore = useCallback(async () => {`) initiates an async operation, but no state tracks this visually or programmatically. - **User Group Impacted**: Screen reader users and cognitive accessibility users. - **WCAG/APG Citation**: WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; WCAG 3.2.1 On Focus (context changes should be predictable). - **Why this matters**: Without a loading indicator, users cannot distinguish between "no more items," "network error," or "still loading." - **Fix**: Track `isLoading` state. Apply `aria-busy="true"` to the list container while fetching, and toggle to `false` when complete. **Major Findings** (significantly degrades experience): 3. **Missing Landmark Structure** - **Evidence**: `src/components/BuggyInfiniteScroll.tsx:42` (`
`). - **User Group Impacted**: Screen reader users navigating by landmarks. - **WCAG/APG Citation**: WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; WAI-ARIA Landmark patterns. - **Why this matters**: The component is a `div` with no role. Screen readers cannot identify this as the main content area, making it harder to navigate or skip to. - **Fix**: Wrap the component in `
` or add `role="main"` to the container div. 4. **List Items Lack Focusability (Assumption Check)** - **Evidence**: `src/components/BuggyInfiniteScroll.tsx:39` (`
  • {item.text}
